title: Bromelia shared definitions
description: Value types used by every other schema: ids, times, messages, secrets and the enumerations shared by the configuration, the archive record, the API and the events. Every platform spells these the same on the wire.

Uuid.description: A UUID in lower case with hyphens. Job, unit, session and configuration entry ids.

ShortId.description: The first 8 hex digits of a UUID, used in file and folder names (bromelia-<unit8>.json).

EntryId.description: Id of an entry in the configuration (library, profile, drive, step, rule, target, notification). Any stable string; new entries get a UUID.

DriveId.description: The engine's id for a physical drive: 'drv-' and the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the drive's normalised identification string (MakeMKV's DRV name, lower case, runs of spaces collapsed), or of 'dev:<device>' when MakeMKV reports no name. Computed by DriveJoin.driveId.

Instant.description: A UTC time, ISO 8601 with milliseconds: 2026-10-02T21:53:04.123Z.

TimeOfDay.description: Local time of day, HH:MM (24 h).

Fingerprint.description: Disc fingerprint, version 1 (docs/configuration.md, 'Discs archived before'). Byte for byte as today.

Path.description: An absolute path on the engine's machine. '~' is expanded by the engine when reading the configuration.

RelativePath.description: A path relative to a library or unit folder, '/' separated, never starting with '/' or containing '..'.

MessageCode.description: A code from shared/messages/codes.json (checked by tools/check-contracts.py).

ParamValue.description: A message parameter: a string, number, boolean, a list of them, a nested message (type message) or a list of messages (type messages).

BroMessage.description: What the engine says, as a code with parameters. Clients render it with shared/messages/<lang>.json.

BroError.description: An expected failure: a code, its parameters and optionally the error that caused it.

SecretRef.description: A secret kept outside the configuration. Resolved from the keystore, then the environment variable BROMELIA_SECRET_<NAME> (upper case, '.' → '_'), then <data>/secrets/<name>.

RipMode.description: What a video-disc job makes. audioCD and dataImage are chosen from the disc's content, never configured as a profile mode.

FormatCode.description: DVD, BR, 4K (HDDVD, DISC); with an 'e' suffix for backups that were not decrypted.

DiscType.description: The {type} token: from the drive's flags or the listing.

Layout.description: templates: the profile's folder and file templates. mediaServer: the Plex / Jellyfin / Emby names (Naming/Layouts).

JobState.description: Where a job is (plan §20.2). A finished job also has an Outcome.

Outcome.description: How a job ended (plan §20.2, decided by Domain/Outcome JobOutcome.decide).

StatusWord.description: The status given to user scripts (BROMELIA_STATUS), notifications and the manifest, as today: success, errors (read errors), failed, cancelled. skipped and interrupted are new; skipped jobs never run steps.

AlreadyArchived.description: A disc archived before, in an automatic rip: skip (outcome skipped, disc ejected when ejectWhenDone), ask (an AwaitingDecision question, disc left in the drive), ripAgain.

UnitState.description: committing: the intent is recorded, items are being moved. committed: in the library. quarantined: in _Quarantine. missing: a rescan didn't find it.

UnitStatus.description: success: a finished archive. errors: every title was saved but MakeMKV reported read errors. incomplete: failed or cancelled.

Page.description: A page of results. Fetch the next page with ?cursor=<next>.
